The business case must be approved by the instructor before week 13 begins. This gate prevents over-engineering and forces students to think before they build.

## Business case requirements
Your document must include:
- Problem statement (precise, not vague)
- Target user and how they will interact with the output
- Success metric (one primary KPI)
- ROI estimate — even a rough one requires assumptions to be stated
- Data source and known limitations
- Risks and ethical considerations

## Deliverable
- Signed-off business case document
